question.zh-CN: 保留每一个观测值；中位数短线便于小样本组间比较。
question.en: Show every observation; a median marker supports small-sample comparisons.

limitation.zh-CN: 不显示组间效应量或其置信区间。
limitation.en: Does not display a between-group effect or its confidence interval.

advantages.zh-CN: 保留每一个观测值；中位数短线便于小样本组间比较。
advantages.en: Show every observation; a median marker supports small-sample comparisons.

information_loss.zh-CN: 不显示组间效应量或其置信区间。
information_loss.en: Does not display a between-group effect or its confidence interval.

question.zh-CN: 同时展示独立样本观测和组间均值差及 Bootstrap 95% CI。
question.en: Show independent observations and the mean difference with a bootstrap 95% CI.

limitation.zh-CN: 调用已有独立组工作台；分析记录包含探索性检验，不自动添加显著性标注。
limitation.en: Uses the existing independent-group workbench; exploratory tests are recorded without automatic significance labels.

advantages.zh-CN: 同时展示独立样本观测和组间均值差及 Bootstrap 95% CI。
advantages.en: Show independent observations and the mean difference with a bootstrap 95% CI.

information_loss.zh-CN: 调用已有独立组工作台；分析记录包含探索性检验，不自动添加显著性标注。
information_loss.en: Uses the existing independent-group workbench; exploratory tests are recorded without automatic significance labels.

question.zh-CN: 比较组均值及其估计不确定性。
question.en: Compare group means and estimation uncertainty.

limitation.zh-CN: t 分布 95% CI；小样本时应同时查看原始观测。
limitation.en: t-based 95% CIs; inspect individual observations alongside them, especially for small samples.

advantages.zh-CN: 比较组均值及其估计不确定性。
advantages.en: Compare group means and estimation uncertainty.

information_loss.zh-CN: t 分布 95% CI；小样本时应同时查看原始观测。
information_loss.en: t-based 95% CIs; inspect individual observations alongside them, especially for small samples.

question.zh-CN: 原始点与四分位数同时呈现，便于比较分布位置和离散程度。
question.en: Show observations with quartiles to compare location and spread.

limitation.zh-CN: 样本少时四分位数不稳定；箱体不是均值置信区间。
limitation.en: Quartiles are unstable in small samples; boxes are not confidence intervals for means.

advantages.zh-CN: 原始点与四分位数同时呈现，便于比较分布位置和离散程度。
advantages.en: Show observations with quartiles to compare location and spread.

information_loss.zh-CN: 样本少时四分位数不稳定；箱体不是均值置信区间。
information_loss.en: Quartiles are unstable in small samples; boxes are not confidence intervals for means.

question.zh-CN: 直接比较低于任一阈值的观察比例，无需分箱或平滑。
question.en: Compare the observed proportion below any threshold without bins or smoothing.

limitation.zh-CN: 小样本的阶梯较粗；不表示连续密度或生存概率。
limitation.en: Small samples produce coarse steps; this is neither a smooth density nor survival analysis.

advantages.zh-CN: 直接比较低于任一阈值的观察比例，无需分箱或平滑。
advantages.en: Compare the observed proportion below any threshold without bins or smoothing.

information_loss.zh-CN: 小样本的阶梯较粗；不表示连续密度或生存概率。
information_loss.en: Small samples produce coarse steps; this is neither a smooth density nor survival analysis.

names.zh-CN: 半小提琴、箱线与原始点

question.zh-CN: 同时比较观测、四分位摘要与估计的分布形态。
question.en: Compare observations, quartile summaries and estimated distribution shape.

limitation.zh-CN: 每组至少 8 个观测且有足够变化；平滑受带宽影响。
limitation.en: Requires at least eight sufficiently varying observations per group; smoothing depends on bandwidth.

estimand.zh-CN: 半小提琴、箱线与原始点

advantages.zh-CN: 同时比较观测、四分位摘要与估计的分布形态。
advantages.en: Compare observations, quartile summaries and estimated distribution shape.

information_loss.zh-CN: 每组至少 8 个观测且有足够变化；平滑受带宽影响。
information_loss.en: Requires at least eight sufficiently varying observations per group; smoothing depends on bandwidth.

question.zh-CN: 连接同一对象的前后测量，保留变化方向与基线。
question.en: Connect each unit’s before/after measurements, retaining baseline and direction.

limitation.zh-CN: 不完整或重复配对被阻止；线条交叉不是显著性证据。
limitation.en: Incomplete or duplicate pairs are blocked; crossed lines do not establish significance.

advantages.zh-CN: 连接同一对象的前后测量，保留变化方向与基线。
advantages.en: Connect each unit’s before/after measurements, retaining baseline and direction.

information_loss.zh-CN: 不完整或重复配对被阻止；线条交叉不是显著性证据。
information_loss.en: Incomplete or duplicate pairs are blocked; crossed lines do not establish significance.

question.zh-CN: 同时查看配对水平和每个对象的变化量。
question.en: Inspect paired levels and each unit’s change.

limitation.zh-CN: 需确认同单位前后值及比较顺序；不自动检验差异。
limitation.en: Confirm comparable measurement units and contrast order; no difference test is automatically performed.

advantages.zh-CN: 同时查看配对水平和每个对象的变化量。
advantages.en: Inspect paired levels and each unit’s change.

information_loss.zh-CN: 需确认同单位前后值及比较顺序；不自动检验差异。
information_loss.en: Confirm comparable measurement units and contrast order; no difference test is automatically performed.

question.zh-CN: 对象标识与前后两次同单位测量；保持配对关系。
question.en: Subject ID and before/after measurements in the same units; preserves pairing.

limitation.zh-CN: 对象标识与前后两次同单位测量；保持配对关系。
limitation.en: Subject ID and before/after measurements in the same units; preserves pairing.

advantages.zh-CN: 对象标识与前后两次同单位测量；保持配对关系。
advantages.en: Subject ID and before/after measurements in the same units; preserves pairing.

information_loss.zh-CN: 对象标识与前后两次同单位测量；保持配对关系。
information_loss.en: Subject ID and before/after measurements in the same units; preserves pairing.

question.zh-CN: 分开显示实验内测量与独立实验均值，保留真实重复层级。
question.en: Separate within-experiment measurements from experiment means, retaining replication levels.

limitation.zh-CN: 技术重复不计作独立样本；该视图仅作描述，不拟合层级模型。
limitation.en: Technical replicates are not independent samples; this descriptive view does not fit a hierarchical model.

advantages.zh-CN: 分开显示实验内测量与独立实验均值，保留真实重复层级。
advantages.en: Separate within-experiment measurements from experiment means, retaining replication levels.

information_loss.zh-CN: 技术重复不计作独立样本；该视图仅作描述，不拟合层级模型。
information_loss.en: Technical replicates are not independent samples; this descriptive view does not fit a hierarchical model.

question.zh-CN: 按真实时间顺序连接同一对象，观察个体轨迹。
question.en: Connect the same units in numeric time order to inspect individual trajectories.

limitation.zh-CN: 同一对象不能跨组或在同一时点重复记录；不做混合模型检验。
limitation.en: Units cannot change groups or duplicate a time point; no mixed-model inference is performed.

advantages.zh-CN: 按真实时间顺序连接同一对象，观察个体轨迹。
advantages.en: Connect the same units in numeric time order to inspect individual trajectories.

information_loss.zh-CN: 同一对象不能跨组或在同一时点重复记录；不做混合模型检验。
information_loss.en: Units cannot change groups or duplicate a time point; no mixed-model inference is performed.

question.zh-CN: 比较每个对象相对共同基线时间的变化。
question.en: Compare each unit’s change from a common baseline time.

limitation.zh-CN: 不显示绝对基线差异；每个对象必须具有共同基线。
limitation.en: Hides absolute baseline differences; every unit must have the common baseline.

advantages.zh-CN: 比较每个对象相对共同基线时间的变化。
advantages.en: Compare each unit’s change from a common baseline time.

information_loss.zh-CN: 不显示绝对基线差异；每个对象必须具有共同基线。
information_loss.en: Hides absolute baseline differences; every unit must have the common baseline.

question.zh-CN: 同时保留每条个体轨迹和逐时点组均值。
question.en: Retain individual trajectories alongside group means at each time.

limitation.zh-CN: 均值不能替代重复测量模型；不完整随访会改变逐时点组成。
limitation.en: Means do not replace a repeated-measures model; incomplete follow-up changes the composition at each time.

advantages.zh-CN: 同时保留每条个体轨迹和逐时点组均值。
advantages.en: Retain individual trajectories alongside group means at each time.

information_loss.zh-CN: 均值不能替代重复测量模型；不完整随访会改变逐时点组成。
information_loss.en: Means do not replace a repeated-measures model; incomplete follow-up changes the composition at each time.

question.en: One pair of continuous measurements per independent subject; an identity line requires the same units.
